fieldData.full-article-text:
Unfortunately, if your country isn’t on the drop-down list, then you will be unable to use Instapass or Instabridge. This is to make sure that we comply with international regulations.


Excluded countries:

In order to comply with international rules and regulations, the following countries are not accepted by Instapass:

Iran

Korea (North)

Myanmar (Burma)

‍

If you are looking to exchange your EXRD for XRD, you could alternatively try using an exchange which has XRD and eXRD available to both purchase and sell.
fieldData.name: Which countries are not accepted by Instapass?
